title: Modern Comfort Only 1.9 Mile to Downtown Broadway
description:
Enjoy ample space and a stylish interior in the heart of East Nashville's hip 5 Points neighborhood. Walking distance to an exciting array of restaurants, live music venues, coffee and bars. FREE Parking and free laundry on-site. TVs in all bedrooms + living room. Only 1.9 miles to Downtown Broadway bars. Located on the 1st floor - no stairs to climb! Fully equipped kitchen and high-speed wifi. This condo's new, chic furnishings create a warm and welcoming environment after exploring Music City.

The space
HIGHLIGHTS: 

★ 8 Beds - 1 King Bed, Queen over Queen Bunk Bed, 5 Twin Beds
★ 4 Bedrooms
★ 2 Full size spacious bathrooms
★ Smart TVs in all bedrooms plus the living room
★ Dining table with seating for 8
★ FREE parking
★ Walk to restaurants, coffee shops, bars, a brewery and shopping
★ Located in the Hip & Trendy East Nashville area called 5 Points 
★ Only 1.9 miles to Downtown Broadway Bars
★ Washer/Dryer onsite, next door to the condo (free to use)
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs
★ Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided
★ High-speed internet
★ Drip coffee machine + filters and coffee grounds provided 
★ Adjustable thermostat
★ Coffee Maker
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes 
★ Located on the 1st floor - no stairs to climb
★ Walking distance to Butcher & Bee, Bartaco, WeWork, 5 Points Pizza, Edley’s BBQ, Basement East, Smith & Lentz Brewery and so much more!
★ Two Grocery stores nearby - Publix and Kroger

BEDS: 
Bedroom 1: 2 Twin Beds
Bedroom 2: 2 Twin Beds
Bedroom 3: Queen over Queen Bunk Bed + Twin Bed
Bedroom 4: 1 King Bed

BATHROOM: 
Bathroom 1: Full size with stand up shower
Bathroom 2: Full size with stand up shower

After a fun day out exploring Nashville, come back to relax in this chic, spacious and comfy condo. The space is the perfect mix of style + comfort. All aspects of the home have been thoughtfully designed with ease + convenience in mind. Although parking is free, you don't need a car for this location. Many things are within walking distance as we are located in one of the most popular areas - 5 Points in East Nashville. The airport is only about 15 minutes away. There are plenty of Ubers, Lyft and taxis available. Our condo is in a great location to enjoy all the things that Nashville has to offer.
